# Municipal Ordinance No. 08, Series of 2018 — Creating the Persons with Disability Affairs Office (PDAO)

## Summary

This ordinance creates the Persons with Disability Affairs Office (PDAO) of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province]], in compliance with [[RA 10070]] (An Act Establishing an Institutional Mechanism to Ensure the Implementation of Programs and Services for Persons with Disabilities in Every Province, City, and Municipality). RA 10070 mandates local government units to establish offices dedicated to the development and implementation of programs and services for persons with disabilities (PWDs). The ordinance draws authority from [[Sec-16-RA7160]] (General Welfare Clause) and [[Sec-447-RA7160]] (Powers of the Sangguniang Bayan).

## Key Provisions

- Creates the Persons with Disability Affairs Office (PDAO) as an office under the municipal government of [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
- Mandates the PDAO to develop, implement, and coordinate programs and services for PWDs in compliance with [[RA 10070]].
- References [[Sec-443-RA7160]] on the officials of the municipal government and office creation.
- Establishes the institutional mechanism at the municipal level to address the needs of persons with disabilities.
